exposure: left ventricular outflow tract obstruction/aortic valve abnormality or coarctation/interrupted aortic arch
hypoplastic left heart syndrome/critical aortic stenosis
cohort: 267 patients who presented to a single center between January 2012 and January 2019 and who had more than one fetal echocardiography performed for structural congenital heart disease
finding: The clinical utility of follow-up fetal echocardiography is associated with the type of congenital heart disease diagnosed.
